adjudication.rationale: The diff materially changes `GroupsController#members` from rendering a bare serialized array to returning an envelope `{ members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }`, and applies pagination to all groups with a new default `limit` of 50 (see `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`). The JS `Discourse.Group#findMembers` now depends on `result.meta.*` and `result.members` to set `user_count/limit/offset/members` (see `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`), which is consumed by both the public members page (`group-members` route + `group/members.hbs` iterating `members`) and the new admin pager (`admin-group.js.es6` using `user_count/offset/limit`). No spec covering this new response shape/pagination logic is added in the diff; the only touched test file is `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, which does not exercise `GroupsController#members`. This is a concrete missing-test gap for a new API contract and pagination behavior, not just generic “add tests.”
